name: darios-logos-modules
description: The Logos wallet stacks: EVM/Ethereum (keystore, signer, RPC, token lists, fees, assets, transaction sending, Uniswap swaps), Bitcoin, Monero and Zcash (each with an optional local node); the signer manager with Keycard and Keycard Shell signers; and the Tor that comes with Logos. With their UIs and logosctl CLIs.
